summary: Applied the provided BOOHTACORD artwork as the Android, macOS, and Windows launcher/application icon while retaining the original image as the asset source.

checks.observation: The macOS AppIcon includes a 1024x1024 image and Android's xxxhdpi launcher image is 192x192; all configured density variants were generated from the supplied square artwork.
Windows ICO resource contains seven PNG-backed sizes: 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256 pixels.
macOS application built successfully with the refreshed AppIcon asset catalog.
Android release APK built successfully as ru.boohtacord.app version 1.0.0+1 and packages launcher icon resources.
APK Signature Scheme v2 verified with the configured upload certificate.
Windows native build and installed-icon visual acceptance on Windows, macOS and Android were not run on this host.
